description: This file defines the ViewModel class VideoDetailsViewModel for managing UI state for video details screen, including like/unlike functionality with optimistic updates, and a ViewModel factory. It handles interactions with a repository to fetch and update like status and count, and manages cached state for immediate UI responsiveness.

classes.name: VideoDetailsViewModel
classes.description: Android ViewModel managing the UI state for video details, including like status and count, with support for optimistic UI updates.

classes.name: VideoDetailsViewModelFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of VideoDetailsViewModel, passing in required repository and video ID.

methods.name: onToggleLike
methods.description: Handles user toggling the like button; performs optimistic UI update, then attempts to persist change via repository; rolls back on failure.

methods.name: reduceOptimisticToggle
methods.description: Static function used for unit testing, computes the next state after a like toggle without side effects.
